title: transcosmos-editorial
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE original Japanese call-center recruitment HERO image, wide landscape aspect about 1938:811 (2.39:1). This is a new site-referenced creative direction, not a website screenshot or a clone.
Input image 1: actual saved website screenshot of トランスコスモス, https://www.trans-cosmos.co.jp/. Study its composition, type hierarchy and imagery treatment. Input image 2: our current call-center image, used ONLY for subject context (headsets, operators, call-center equipment), not its repeated anime arrangement.
Observed reference element: 横方向の情報帯と整理されたモジュール配置。業務の種類を並べて俯瞰できる構造を人物写真へ翻訳する。
Direction: Use the transcosmos screenshot only for its organized HORIZONTAL INFORMATION STRIPS and structured modules, translated into a much cleaner original call-center recruitment hero. White background with headline in navy spanning the TOP-LEFT/center. Below and across RIGHT two adjacent broad editorial photo strips show distinct real call-center moments: a Japanese operator on a headset call and two colleagues consulting a script at a workstation. Thin cobalt separators and short exact small labels 電話対応 and チーム; a small white gutter makes work modes readable. Structured editorial feature-spread composition, no source news, client logos, statistics, award claims, mini cards or website navigation. Keep overall sparse and human-centered.
Exact ORIGINAL approved copy: small label "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline "声を届ける、" / "仕事を知ろう。"; subcopy "電話対応も、チームの相談も。". Use these strings ONLY, plus 電話対応 / 営業 / サポート / チーム if small work labels are needed. Do not copy any text from the attached website screenshot.
Keep call-center theme recognizable: professional communications headsets worn on heads with natural boom microphones, customer-contact workstation/screens with unreadable interface text, desk telephone or call-script papers. All human foreground staff Japanese adults. Natural proportions and coherent anatomy. Photographic concepts must be photographs; illustrative/sculptural concepts must follow their distinct direction.
Palette: mostly white, navy, cobalt blue and pale blue/teal, natural skin tones. The attached site's other brand colors are reference context, not output requirements. Keep bright edges that suit a white page, with no full dark rectangular background.
NO copied company logos, brands, slogans, named people, identity recreation, dates, certifications, customer quotes, salary/benefit promises, numerical claims, header/navigation, website CTA, browser chrome, watermarks or multiple concept thumbnails. No company-specific recruitment conditions. Preserve legibility, avoid cropped lettering or faces. Output exactly one finished opaque hero image, not a full page.
borrowed_visual_element: 横方向の情報帯と整理されたモジュール配置。業務の種類を並べて俯瞰できる構造を人物写真へ翻訳する。

visual_inspection.headline: exact and readable
visual_inspection.reference_composition: two structured photographic modules with blue horizontal information bands
visual_inspection.callcenter: foreground operators wear headsets; female boom microphones clear; team script review at workstation
visual_inspection.source_brand: no copied source brand, claim, client name or stats
